title: 摩洛哥丹吉爾—蓋尼特拉高速鐵路~Tangier–Kenitra high-speed railway
focus: 新興高速走廊既有線銜接與能源~Emerging high speed corridor interfaces and energy
summary: 以摩洛哥丹吉爾至蓋尼特拉高速線為背景，建立高速專用段與既有網路連接的教學走廊。學徒比較不同區段速度、供電和停站模式，追蹤旅客轉乘及列車循環，並用原創算例檢查能源改善是否只是把負荷轉移到另一時段。~Use Morocco’s Tangier–Kenitra high-speed line to construct a teaching corridor joining a dedicated fast section to an existing network. Compare section speeds, supply boundaries and stopping patterns. Track passenger connections and train circulation, and test whether an apparent energy improvement merely shifts demand to another time instead of reducing total delivered energy.
example: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 catch_time=624 s；單元 2 得 transition=2846.031 m；單元 3 得 exit_speed=49.37206 m/s。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 gap 的擾動測試，結果改為 686.4 s；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以摩洛哥丹吉爾至蓋尼特拉高速線為背景，建立高速專用段與既有網路連接的教學走廊。學徒比較不同區段速度、供電和停站模式，追蹤旅客轉乘及列車循環，並用原創算例檢查能源改善是否只是把負荷轉移到另一時段。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。~Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives catch_time=624 s; unit 2 gives transition=2846.031 m; unit 3 gives exit_speed=49.37206 m/s. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing gap in the first unit changes its result to 686.4 s. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use Morocco’s Tangier–Kenitra high-speed line to construct a teaching corridor joining a dedicated fast section to an existing network. Compare section speeds, supply boundaries and stopping patterns. Track passenger connections and train circulation, and test whether an apparent energy improvement merely shifts demand to another time instead of reducing total delivered energy. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
history: 公開工程與出版時間線：2018 年：摩洛哥阿爾波拉克高速服務正式揭幕；2019 年：摩洛哥國家鐵路發布阿爾波拉克一周年營運回顧。這些事件由下列機構來源提供背景，不表示來源公開了本課程所有設計數據。以摩洛哥丹吉爾至蓋尼特拉高速線為背景，建立高速專用段與既有網路連接的教學走廊。學徒比較不同區段速度、供電和停站模式，追蹤旅客轉乘及列車循環，並用原創算例檢查能源改善是否只是把負荷轉移到另一時段。 本課程另以可靠度、可用度、可維修度與安全方法整理需求、證據和變更邊界；歷史年份屬可查證事項，數學模型的輸入則是明示的教學假設。~Public engineering and publication chronology: 2018: Morocco inaugurated Al Boraq high-speed service; 2019: ONCF published a first-anniversary review of Al Boraq operations. The institutional sources below establish this background; they do not imply publication of every design input in this course. Use Morocco’s Tangier–Kenitra high-speed line to construct a teaching corridor joining a dedicated fast section to an existing network. Compare section speeds, supply boundaries and stopping patterns. Track passenger connections and train circulation, and test whether an apparent energy improvement merely shifts demand to another time instead of reducing total delivered energy. The course separately uses reliability, availability, maintainability and safety reasoning to organise requirements, evidence and change boundaries. Historical dates are verifiable facts, whereas numerical model inputs are explicitly declared teaching assumptions.

units.anchor: 快慢車追及與待避~Fast-slow train catch-up
units.title: 快慢車追及與待避~Fast-slow train catch-up
units.mechanism: 快車在同一路段追上慢車的時間取決於初始間距除相對速度。這個簡單關係能辨認待避需求，但實際時刻表還需加入停站、進路鎖閉與加減速；追及點不是允許兩車接近的安全距離。 追趕時間取決於起始間隔和兩列相對速度，不能只看快車速度。若兩列會停站或受訊號限制，速度必須改成分段函數，並把進路占用放回事件圖。 在高速段出口檢查快車追上既有線列車的時間裕度。~Catch-up time on a shared section is initial separation divided by relative speed. This relation identifies the need for overtaking opportunities, but real timetables also include stops, route locking and acceleration. The meeting point is not a permitted safe separation between trains. Catch-up time depends on starting separation and relative speed, not only the faster train’s speed. If either train stops or encounters signalling constraints, use piecewise speed functions and restore route occupation to the event diagram. Check catch-up margin where a fast train exits onto infrastructure shared with slower services.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：gap=12480 m; fast=60 m/s; slow=40 m/s；計算：catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=624 s。敏感度：gap 單獨增加百分之十至 13728 m，其餘固定，結果為 686.4 s。模型邊界：同向恆速且快車較快；不含號誌保護和停站。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: gap=12480 m; fast=60 m/s; slow=40 m/s; calculation: catch_time=gap/(fast-slow)=624 s. Sensitivity: gap, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 13728 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 686.4 s. Model boundary: Same-direction constant speeds with a faster following train; signalling protection and stops are excluded.
units.verify: 用列車運行圖標出快慢車路徑與停站，把相交位置對照可待避地點，並核對道岔與站台實際占用時間。 以逐站到發時刻重建距離時間圖，核對起始間隔和各段速度，並標示待避占用。~Plot fast and slow trajectories including stops, compare intersections with overtaking locations, and verify actual point and platform occupation times. Rebuild a distance-time diagram from station arrivals and departures, verifying initial separation and segment speeds and marking passing occupation.
units.failure: 只看區間平均速度可能把追及位置判錯；慢車停站時間波動會改變待避窗口並將延誤傳給快車。 快慢車速度相同時不能用追趕公式分母，須重設工況。~Using section-average speed can misplace the catch-up location; variable stopping time shifts overtaking windows and passes delay to the fast train. Equal train speeds invalidate the catch-up denominator; redefine the operating case.
units.misconception: 快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量~Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity.
units.practice: 增加慢車停站與快車出發延後各一個情境，畫出時空圖，討論待避線能解決的衝突與仍存在的交叉進路限制。 再以本單元 gap 的對照值重算 catch_time，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Add a slow-train stop and a delayed fast departure as separate cases, draw time-distance diagrams, and distinguish conflicts solved by a loop from remaining crossing-route restrictions. Also recalculate catch_time for the alternative gap value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 速度限制轉換與預告距離~Speed-limit transition and warning distance
units.title: 速度限制轉換與預告距離~Speed-limit transition and warning distance
units.mechanism: 進入較低速區前需把速度差轉成足夠的減速距離，能量式包含初速與目標速度的平方差。此處用明示減速度得到教學距離，真正保護曲線還需加入定位誤差、坡度、制動建立及車輛差異。 目標速度不一定是零，進入較低速區也需要保護距離。計算使用同一距離基準與速度單位，並把定位誤差和延遲裕度分開，才能避免重複或漏加安全邊界。 將高速段至低速區的目標速度分段建立保護曲線。~Before entering a lower-speed section, the train needs distance to remove the difference in kinetic energy. The expression contains the difference of squared initial and target speeds. A teaching deceleration gives one distance; a real protection curve additionally needs position uncertainty, gradient, brake build-up and vehicle variation. The target speed need not be zero: entry into a lower-speed section also requires protection distance. Use one distance reference and consistent speed units. Keep localisation uncertainty and delay margins separate to prevent duplicated or omitted boundaries. Build staged protection curves for the transition from fast running to a lower-speed section.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：initial=72.8 m/s; target=40 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2；計算：transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=2846.031 m。敏感度：initial 單獨增加百分之十至 80.08 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 3702.159 m。模型邊界：初速大於目標速度且定減速度；沒有通訊延遲與安全裕度。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: initial=72.8 m/s; target=40 m/s; a=0.65 m/s^2; calculation: transition=(initial**2-target**2)/(2*a)=2846.031 m. Sensitivity: initial, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 80.08 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 3702.159 m. Model boundary: Initial speed above target and constant deceleration; communication delay and safety margins are excluded.
units.verify: 重播速度剖面並檢查每個限制點的里程基準，將定位誤差和煞車建立時間分別加入，不以單次成功停準代替整個包絡驗證。 以已知初速與目標速度重播控制資料，核對速度單位、里程方向及列車前端參考位置。~Replay speed profiles with a common distance datum, add positioning error and brake build-up separately, and do not substitute one successful stop for verification of the full envelope. Replay control data at known initial and target speeds, checking speed units, chainage direction and the reference position of the train front.
units.failure: 限制點座標偏移或單位錯誤會使制動開始過晚；過度依賴平均減速度則可能漏掉低黏著條件下的長制動距離。 若目標速度高於初速，此減速模型的工況設定便不成立。~A shifted restriction coordinate or unit error causes late braking, while reliance on mean deceleration can miss long stopping distances under low adhesion. If target speed exceeds initial speed, the stated deceleration case no longer applies.
units.misconception: 降低目標速度時可忽略初速與目標速度的平方差~Reducing target speed allows the squared-speed difference to be ignored.
units.practice: 對同一初速設定兩個目標速度，重算轉換距離，畫出能量差並說明為何不能按速度差線性縮放距離。 再以本單元 initial 的對照值重算 transition，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Use two target speeds at one initial speed, recalculate transition distance, plot the energy differences, and explain why distance cannot scale linearly with the speed difference. Also recalculate transition for the alternative initial value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 無電區惰行與速度損失~Coasting through an unpowered section
units.title: 無電區惰行與速度損失~Coasting through an unpowered section
units.mechanism: 列車通過無電區時需依靠動能克服阻力，簡化恆阻力模型把阻力做功從初始動能扣除。區段長度、初速與坡度決定剩餘速度，供電切換邏輯和防誤合閘仍需獨立驗證。 無牽引不等於無運動，列車以動能克服所宣告的阻力。若距離超過此阻力下的可滑行距離，平方根將無實數解，表示通過情境不成立而非計算器錯誤。 比較供電分界前不同入口速度的無動力滑行距離。~A train coasting through an unpowered section uses kinetic energy to overcome resistance. A constant-resistance model subtracts work from initial kinetic energy. Length, entry speed and gradient determine remaining speed, while switching logic and prevention of inappropriate re-energisation require separate verification. No traction does not mean no motion: kinetic energy overcomes the declared resistance. If the section exceeds the available coasting distance, the square root has no real solution, indicating an infeasible passage case rather than a calculator malfunction. Compare unpowered coasting distance at a supply boundary for different entry speeds.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=50 m/s; force=15600 N; length=500 m; mass=250000 kg；計算：exit_speed=(v*v-2*force*length/mass)**0.5=49.37206 m/s。敏感度：force 單獨增加百分之十至 17160 N，其餘固定，結果為 49.30882 m/s。模型邊界：水平路線且恆阻力，根號內必須非負；不含低速停車及切換暫態。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=50 m/s; force=15600 N; length=500 m; mass=250000 kg; calculation: exit_speed=(v*v-2*force*length/mass)**0.5=49.37206 m/s. Sensitivity: force, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 17160 N, with all other inputs fixed, gives 49.30882 m/s. Model boundary: Level track and constant resistance with a nonnegative radicand; stopping within the section and switching transients are excluded.
units.verify: 同步記錄受電電壓、主斷路器狀態和列車速度，確認無電區邊界與里程一致，再核對惰行能量差。 以入口和出口獨立速度對照滑行距離，核對斷電區時間戳及坡度是否被模型排除。~Synchronise line voltage, main-breaker status and speed, align electrical boundaries with distance coordinates, and check the coasting energy difference. Compare independently measured entry and exit speeds with coasting distance, checking power-off timestamps and whether gradient is excluded.
units.failure: 邊界定位誤差可能使主斷路器切換時機錯誤；把坡度阻力遺漏會低估上坡無電區的速度下降。 若計算顯示無法通過，不能把負根號截成零後繼續排程。~Boundary-position error can mistime breaker switching; omitting gradient resistance understates speed loss in an uphill unpowered section. If passage is infeasible, do not clamp a negative radicand to zero and continue scheduling.
units.misconception: 無電區長度改變不會影響列車離開時的速度~Changing the length of an unpowered section cannot change exit speed.
units.practice: 在相同初速下增加區段長度，檢查能量是否足夠通過，再列出電氣切換與機械惰行模型各自需要的驗證資料。 再以本單元 force 的對照值重算 exit_speed，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase section length at fixed entry speed, test whether energy remains sufficient, and list separate evidence for electrical switching and mechanical coasting models. Also recalculate exit_speed for the alternative force value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 牽引饋線壓降~Traction feeder voltage drop
units.title: 牽引饋線壓降~Traction feeder voltage drop
units.mechanism: 牽引電流經導體與回流路徑產生壓降，電壓下降又可能讓定功率列車要求更大電流，形成非線性負荷互動。單一電阻模型先隔離線路損耗，再逐步引入雙端供電和多列車位置。 回路電阻必須包含饋電與回流路徑，還需說明是否納入接頭和變電站等效阻抗。電流固定是簡化；實際定功率負載在電壓降低時可能增加電流並擴大壓降。 在接續區段定義完整供電回路，避免只計一條導線壓降。~Current through the feeder and return path creates voltage drop. A constant-power train may draw more current as voltage falls, creating nonlinear load interaction. A single resistance model first isolates line loss before adding two-ended supply and multiple train positions. Loop resistance must include supply and return paths, with joints and substation equivalent impedance explicitly included or excluded. Fixed current is a simplification: a constant-power load can draw more current as voltage falls and thereby increase the drop. Define the complete supply loop at the connection rather than only one conductor’s voltage drop.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：current=1560 A; resistance=0.06 ohm；計算：drop=current*resistance=93.6 V。敏感度：current 單獨增加百分之十至 1716 A，其餘固定，結果為 102.96 V。模型邊界：固定電流與集中等效電阻；不含回生、功率因數與暫態。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: current=1560 A; resistance=0.06 ohm; calculation: drop=current*resistance=93.6 V. Sensitivity: current, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1716 A, with all other inputs fixed, gives 102.96 V. Model boundary: Fixed current and lumped equivalent resistance; regeneration, power factor and transients are excluded.
units.verify: 同步量測變電所與列車端電壓及電流，記錄列車位置，將接頭接觸電阻與導體溫度造成的變化分別辨識。 同步量測供電端與受電端電壓及回路電流，核對接線極性和設備接頭的額外壓降。~Synchronise substation and train voltage and current measurements, log train position, and distinguish joint contact resistance from conductor-temperature changes. Measure supply voltage, receiving voltage and loop current synchronously, checking polarity and extra voltage drops across equipment connections.
units.failure: 高阻接頭可能在總壓降看似可接受時局部過熱；把導體長度和回流路徑計算一半會系統性低估損耗。 需核對回流路徑，否則可能把接頭故障藏在錯估電阻中。~A high-resistance joint may overheat while total drop looks modest; omitting part of the return path systematically understates resistance and losses. Verify the return path so a faulty connection is not hidden inside an incorrect resistance estimate.
units.misconception: 量到變電所輸出電壓正常就代表所有列車端電壓正常~Normal substation output voltage proves that every train receives normal voltage.
units.practice: 加入第二列同時加速的列車，畫出共享與非共享饋線段，分段重算壓降並說明何時需改用完整潮流分析。 再以本單元 current 的對照值重算 drop，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Add a second accelerating train, distinguish shared and separate feeder sections, recalculate each drop, and explain when a complete load-flow analysis becomes necessary. Also recalculate drop for the alternative current value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 再生煞車能量與受電條件~Regenerative energy and receptivity
units.title: 再生煞車能量與受電條件~Regenerative energy and receptivity
units.mechanism: 煞車可回收的能量上限來自列車動能，但電網是否能接受能量、逆變器效率與輔助負載會改變實際回送量。把機械可回收量和變電站收到的電量分開，才不會把理想效率當成節電實績。 效率係數應涵蓋已宣告的轉換鏈；若把網路接受率也納入，必須說明觀測時間窗。只從速度差估計可回收量，不能辨認能量流向電網、電阻或輔助設備。 對不同停站模式比較可回收能量與同時受電條件。~Train kinetic energy sets an upper bound on regenerative recovery, but network receptivity, converter efficiency and auxiliary demand determine actual delivery. Separating mechanically recoverable energy from electricity received at a substation prevents ideal efficiency from being reported as measured savings. The efficiency must cover a declared conversion chain. If it includes network receptivity, the observation window must be stated. A speed change alone cannot identify how energy divides among the supply network, braking resistors and auxiliary equipment. Compare recoverable energy and simultaneous receptivity for different stopping patterns.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mass=249600 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1；計算：recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=14.08333 kWh。敏感度：mass 單獨增加百分之十至 274560 kg，其餘固定，結果為 15.49167 kWh。模型邊界：一次水平減速、固定總效率；不含阻力及架線電壓限制導致的截斷。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mass=249600 kg; v=25 m/s; eta=0.65 1; calculation: recovered=0.5*mass*v*v*eta/3.6e6=14.08333 kWh. Sensitivity: mass, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 274560 kg, with all other inputs fixed, gives 15.49167 kWh. Model boundary: One level deceleration with fixed overall efficiency; resistance and voltage-limited curtailment are excluded.
units.verify: 同步積分直流鏈、受電端與制動電阻的功率，對照初末速度；將輔助用電和回送電量用一致符號處理。 檢查功率計正負方向與積分時間邊界，以能量平衡殘差確認回送量未被重複計入。~Integrate DC-link, line-side and braking-resistor power synchronously and compare initial and final speeds, treating auxiliary consumption and exported energy with consistent signs. Check meter polarity and integration boundaries, then use the energy-balance residual to confirm that exported energy has not been counted twice.
units.failure: 鄰車不在受電時再生電壓可能升高而轉入電阻制動；只量逆變器端會高估真正回到供電網的能量。 若回送受限，需查架線電壓及電阻制動記錄。~Without a receptive neighbouring train, voltage can rise and trigger resistor braking; measurement only at the inverter can overstate energy returned to the supply network. When export is curtailed, inspect line-voltage and resistor-braking records together.
units.misconception: 只要列車裝有再生煞車全部動能都能回到電網~Installing regenerative braking returns all train kinetic energy to the supply network.
units.practice: 比較有受電列車與無受電列車兩種功率時間圖，做能量收支表，提出儲能需求並說明額定能量不等於可接受功率。 再以本單元 mass 的對照值重算 recovered，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare power traces with and without a receptive train, build an energy balance, and size an illustrative storage requirement while distinguishing energy capacity from acceptable power. Also recalculate recovered for the alternative mass value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 空氣阻力與牽引功率~Aerodynamic drag and traction power
units.title: 空氣阻力與牽引功率~Aerodynamic drag and traction power
units.mechanism: 高速列車的空氣阻力與速度平方成正比，而克服此阻力所需功率再乘一次速度，形成三次方敏感度。有效阻力面積包含外形與附屬物影響；會車、隧道及側風會使定常自由場模型失效。 阻力是速度平方關係，而牽引功率還要乘一次速度。把逆風納入時應使用相對空氣速度；滾動阻力與坡度功率是另外的能量途徑，不能被此氣動項取代。 計算高速專用段的氣動功率，與行車時間節省並列。~Aerodynamic drag scales with speed squared, and the power needed to overcome it adds another speed factor. Effective drag area includes shape and attachments. Passing trains, tunnels and crosswinds can invalidate the steady open-air approximation even when the nominal speed remains unchanged. Drag varies with squared speed, while traction power introduces another speed factor. Headwind requires relative air speed. Rolling resistance and gradient power are separate energy paths and cannot be replaced by this aerodynamic term. Calculate aerodynamic power on the dedicated fast section alongside the travel-time saving.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1.2 kg/m^3; CdA=10 m^2; v=72.8 m/s；計算：power=0.5*rho*CdA*v**3/1000=2314.97 kW。敏感度：v 單獨增加百分之十至 80.08 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 3081.225 kW。模型邊界：定常靜風且阻力面積固定；僅空氣阻力功率，不含輪軌阻力與效率。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: rho=1.2 kg/m^3; CdA=10 m^2; v=72.8 m/s; calculation: power=0.5*rho*CdA*v**3/1000=2314.97 kW. Sensitivity: v, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 80.08 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 3081.225 kW. Model boundary: Steady still air and constant drag area; aerodynamic power only, excluding rolling resistance and conversion losses.
units.verify: 在相同編組與天候下做不同速度的惰行分析，記錄風速方向與車頭迎角，避免把坡度造成的加速度誤判成空阻。 同步紀錄風向風速與地速，將穩速段牽引功率扣除可辨識的坡度和輔助負載。~Compare coast-down observations across speeds with the same consist, log wind speed and direction, and separate gradient acceleration from aerodynamic resistance. Record wind vector and ground speed together, then remove identifiable gradient and auxiliary loads from steady-running traction power.
units.failure: 車底設備改變或側風會改變有效阻力面積；若只以單一速度校準，仍可能在另一速度得到錯誤牽引需求。 需核對風向，避免把順風和逆風的相對速度互換。~Underbody changes and crosswinds alter effective drag area; fitting one speed can still produce a wrong traction requirement at another speed. Check wind direction to avoid reversing the relative-speed treatment of headwind and tailwind.
units.misconception: 速度增加一成時克服空氣阻力的功率只增加一成~A ten percent speed increase raises aerodynamic power by only ten percent.
units.practice: 對速度增加一成與阻力面積減少一成各算一次，對比功率節省，並把輪軌阻力另列以避免誇大整列節能比例。 再以本單元 v 的對照值重算 power，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Calculate a ten percent speed increase and a ten percent drag-area reduction separately, compare power changes, and keep rolling resistance separate from whole-train energy savings. Also recalculate power for the alternative v value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力~Long-rail temperature and restrained stress
units.title: 長軌溫升與受限熱應力~Long-rail temperature and restrained stress
units.mechanism: 自由鋼軌升溫會伸長，完全拘束的理想鋼軌則把熱應變轉成壓應力。鎖定軌溫決定應力零點而空氣溫度不等於鋼軌溫度；實際扣件滑移與軌道側向阻力還會改變穩定問題。 溫差應相對於鋼軌實際無應力狀態，而非任意室溫。完全拘束估算給出軸向應力尺度；當扣件滑移或軌道彎曲出現時，需要位移相容和側向穩定分析。 將鋼軌溫度和維修後拘束狀態作為熱應力的獨立輸入。~A free rail expands on heating, while an ideally restrained rail converts thermal strain into compression. Stress-free rail temperature defines the reference and differs from air temperature. Fastener slip and lateral track resistance additionally govern stability, beyond the one-dimensional thermal-stress estimate. Temperature change must reference the rail’s actual stress-free state, not an arbitrary room temperature. Full restraint gives an axial stress scale. Fastener slip or track curvature requires displacement compatibility and lateral stability analysis beyond this expression. Treat rail temperature and post-maintenance restraint as independent thermal-stress inputs.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=31.2 K；計算：compression=E*alpha*deltaT=75.348 MPa。敏感度：deltaT 單獨增加百分之十至 34.32 K，其餘固定，結果為 82.8828 MPa。模型邊界：完全軸向拘束與線彈性；不計挫曲、初彎、殘留應力及塑性。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: E=210000 MPa; alpha=1.15e-05 1/K; deltaT=31.2 K; calculation: compression=E*alpha*deltaT=75.348 MPa. Sensitivity: deltaT, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 34.32 K, with all other inputs fixed, gives 82.8828 MPa. Model boundary: Full axial restraint and linear elasticity; buckling, initial curvature, residual stress and plasticity are excluded.
units.verify: 量鋼軌本體溫度與縱向應變，記錄鎖定狀態和扣件維修歷程，用不同位置感測器區分局部溫差與整段受限變形。 以鋼軌接觸式溫度計校驗遙測值，核對應變零點，並保留日夜循環的升降溫路徑。~Measure rail temperature and longitudinal strain, record the fastening and maintenance history, and use spatially separated sensors to distinguish local heating from restrained segment behaviour. Calibrate remote readings against a contact rail thermometer, verify strain zero, and retain heating and cooling paths across the daily cycle.
units.failure: 把氣溫直接當成鋼軌溫度會錯估熱荷載；扣件鬆動可能降低局部軸力卻增加位移，不能據此宣稱整體穩定性改善。 需查鎖定軌溫紀錄，不能以當天最低氣溫當無應力點。~Substituting air temperature misstates thermal loading; loose fasteners may reduce local force while increasing displacement, which does not prove improved overall stability. Check stress-free-temperature records rather than using the day’s minimum air temperature as the reference.
units.misconception: 完全拘束的鋼軌升溫仍會無應力地自由伸長~A fully restrained rail still expands freely without stress when heated.
units.practice: 畫出自由、部分拘束與完全拘束三種邊界，重算熱變形或應力，標明哪些輸入必須由鋼軌溫度及扣件試驗取得。 再以本單元 deltaT 的對照值重算 compression，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Draw free, partial and full restraint boundaries, recalculate expansion or stress, and identify inputs requiring rail-temperature measurements and fastener tests. Also recalculate compression for the alternative deltaT value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕~Transfer walking and connection margin
units.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕~Transfer walking and connection margin
units.mechanism: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。 距離除速度只表示行走或移動時間，等待列車、排隊和辨識路徑應另列。使用單一平均速度會掩蓋行李、行動能力和雙向干擾，應以分段分群資料檢查。 把轉乘步行與候車分開，檢查班表銜接對總旅程的效果。~A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting. Accessible routes need their own timing rather than an assumed common walking speed. Distance divided by speed represents movement only; train waiting, queueing and wayfinding need separate terms. One mean speed hides baggage, mobility differences and opposing flow. Check the result with segmented measurements for relevant passenger groups. Separate transfer walking from waiting and examine timetable coordination over the complete journey.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=187.2 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=67.8 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 205.92 m，其餘固定，結果為 49.08 s。模型邊界：固定步速與額外時間；不包含動態排隊或旅客個別差異分布。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=187.2 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=67.8 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 205.92 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 49.08 s. Model boundary: Fixed walking speed and additional time; dynamic queues and individual variability distributions are excluded.
units.verify: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。 在路徑起終點對時，逐段記錄水平、垂直與等待時間，核對是否漏計驗票或排隊。~Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Synchronise route endpoints, record horizontal movement, vertical movement and waiting separately, and check for omitted gate processing or queues.
units.failure: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 旅客走錯路會改變實際距離，需比較引導前後的路徑。~Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Wrong turns change actual distance; compare observed routes before and after guidance changes.
units.misconception: 轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接~The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
units.practice: 比較一般與無障礙兩條路徑的餘裕，加入一台電梯停機情境，說明時刻表調整與空間導引分別能改善哪一段。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare connection margins for ordinary and accessible routes, add one unavailable lift, and distinguish improvements from timetable changes versus spatial guidance. Also recalculate margin for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 周轉時間與車隊需求~Round-trip time and fleet size
units.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求~Round-trip time and fleet size
units.mechanism: 維持固定班距所需列車數取決於完整周轉時間除班距並向上取整，周轉包含兩端折返與停站。備用車和維修車需另列；只用單程行車時間會把車隊需求低估接近一半。 循環時間除以班距後必須向上取整，半列車不能提供完整班次。此數量是投入循環的最低值，維修備用、延誤緩衝與不同分支運轉仍需額外配置。 讓慢速接續段時間進入完整車組循環，避免低估用車數。~Fleet requirement for fixed headway is round-trip cycle time divided by headway, rounded upward. The cycle includes terminal turnbacks and stops. Spares and maintenance vehicles are additional; using only one-way running time can underestimate the requirement by nearly half. Divide cycle time by headway and round upward because a fraction of a train cannot provide a full departure. This is the minimum circulating requirement; maintenance spares, delay buffers and branch-specific operation need additional allocation. Include time on the slower connecting section in the complete fleet cycle.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：cycle=5616 s; headway=180 s；計算：fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=32 trains。敏感度：cycle 單獨增加百分之十至 6177.6 s，其餘固定，結果為 35 trains。模型邊界：固定周轉與班距、無延誤；不含備用率和維修排程。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: cycle=5616 s; headway=180 s; calculation: fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=32 trains. Sensitivity: cycle, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 6177.6 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 35 trains. Model boundary: Fixed cycle and headway without delays; reserve ratio and maintenance scheduling are excluded.
units.verify: 逐列串接實際到發時間檢查周轉，將折返與等待分開，並對尖峰班距需求與可出車數建立同一時點的清單。 核對往返與折返時間使用同一單位，以逐列時刻表重播，檢查每次發車是否有車可用。~Join actual arrival and departure logs by train, separate turnback from waiting, and compare peak headway requirements with trains available at the same time. Verify consistent units for round-trip and turnaround times, replay a train-by-train timetable, and check vehicle availability at every departure.
units.failure: 列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。 循環時間稍增可能跨過整數門檻，不能只比較百分比。~Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable. A small cycle-time increase can cross an integer fleet threshold; percentages alone are insufficient.
units.misconception: 車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定~Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone.
units.practice: 增加一端折返時間後重算車隊，檢查向上取整造成的跳變，再提出維修備用與臨時故障應如何另列。 再以本單元 cycle 的對照值重算 fleet，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Increase one terminal turnback time, recalculate fleet and examine rounding jumps, then explain separate allowances for maintenance reserve and unexpected failures. Also recalculate fleet for the alternative cycle value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

units.anchor: 可用度與修復時間~Availability and repair time
units.title: 可用度與修復時間~Availability and repair time
units.mechanism: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。 平均故障間隔和平均修復時間必須使用相同服務邊界；備件等待與到場時間若被排除，數字就不能描述旅客看到的中斷。短期樣本也應報告事件數與觀測時間。 比較高速專用段和共同設備的停機事件對全程服務的影響。~In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved. Spares, travel and diagnosis all affect actual restoration time. Mean time between failures and mean repair time require a common service boundary. Excluding spare-part waiting or travel time prevents the figure from describing passenger-visible interruption. Short samples should also report event count and observation duration. Compare how outages on the dedicated fast section and shared equipment affect end-to-end service.
units.model: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1248 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968051 1。敏感度：mtbf 單獨增加百分之十至 1372.8 h，其餘固定，結果為 0.9970947 1。模型邊界：兩狀態穩態平均模型；不含計畫維修、共同原因與降級服務品質。~Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1248 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9968051 1. Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1372.8 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9970947 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded.
units.verify: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。~Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours.
units.failure: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。~Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints.
units.misconception: 設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低~High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
units.practice: 比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。~Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

教學假設，單元 2：initial=72.8 m/s，計算 transition=2846.031 m；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 2: initial=72.8 m/s, calculated transition=2846.031 m; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 3：force=15600 N，計算 exit_speed=49.37206 m/s；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 3: force=15600 N, calculated exit_speed=49.37206 m/s; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 4：current=1560 A，計算 drop=93.6 V；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 4: current=1560 A, calculated drop=93.6 V; not measured performance.
教學假設，單元 5：mass=249600 kg，計算 recovered=14.08333 kWh；非實測性能。~Teaching assumption, unit 5: mass=249600 kg, calculated recovered=14.08333 kWh; not measured performance.
